seo.title: DataChannel | Reliable ELT, Reverse ETL & Conversational BI Platform
seo.description: Integrate, access, analyze and activate your data instantly. Reliable ETL, powerful orchestration and AI-driven natural language querying in a single platform.

hero.title: Empower every decision
hero.subtitle: Integrate, access, analyze and activate your data instantly. With reliable data integration (ETL), powerful orchestration, and AI-driven natural language querying, eliminate technical barriers and make data accessible to all — so your business can make smarter, faster decisions.

logos.title: Join the growing list of data-driven companies transforming their data stack with DataChannel

reviews.title: See what the software community has to say about us

platform.title: Single platform for reliable & scalable ETL / Reverse ETL pipelines
platform.subtitle: Spending excessively on multiple complex tools? Efficiently scale data ops and go from raw data to insights using a single platform custom built for your data and business teams — and save up to 75% of your costs.

features.title: Choose from the most popular cloud data warehouses
features.body: Don't want the hassle of managing a data warehouse? We are the only platform that offers an integrated managed data warehouse to meet all your data management needs.

features.title: Start leveraging your data in minutes
features.body: Select from a growing library of 100+ fully managed connectors and 20+ destinations — SaaS apps, databases, data warehouses, and more.

features.title: Granular control & data visibility
features.body: Completely secure, granular control over what data to move. Schedule and transform your data for analytics in sync with your pipelines. Preview data in your warehouse without SQL workbenches.

neo.title: Your AI-powered conversational data analyst
neo.subtitle: Talk to your data in natural language. No need to learn SQL or write complex queries.

features.title: Go from questions to insights in seconds
features.body: Bring your data to life with Ask Neo. Talk to Neo in natural language and get answers to all your queries without writing complex SQL or code.

features.title: Customise and control the data Neo can access
features.body: Data teams use customisable data visibility settings and retain complete control. Add context and a glossary of metrics and calculations to improve Neo's understanding of your business data.

features.title: Control and security you can trust
features.body: Keep your data secure and compliant with customizable access control. Manage user permissions to restrict access to sensitive data — governance without compromising on agility.

activation.title: Activate your data with DataChannel
activation.subtitle: Reverse ETL: send data from your warehouse to any marketing, sales, or business application of your choice.

features.title: Leverage the power of your data warehouse as a CDP
features.body: Build a 360° view of your customer in your data warehouse, retain complete control over sensitive customer data and empower your business SaaS applications.

features.title: Create & manage audiences with a no-code audience builder
features.body: Create customer segments — no SQL required. With our point-and-click audience builder, business teams can segment customers and create cohorts without relying on data teams.

features.title: Go beyond dashboards & create alerts on your warehouse
features.body: Constantly checking dashboards is a thing of the past. Get proactive notifications in your existing messaging stack as your data changes.

featured.headline: DataChannel makes ETL easy, effective & efficient.
featured.quote: All we did was set up a few pipelines by entering our credentials and tweaking some source-specific parameters like breakdown criteria, frequency of update, etc. to suit our client's needs, and that's it. Now, thirty different sources are being automatically aggregated & delivered into our AWS Redshift warehouse, at a granularity and frequency of our choosing, without us ever writing a single piece of code.
